prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 16:10 landscape, first viewport plus a visible beginning of the second section
Primary request: Design a bold, production-grade homepage comp for the Brazilian ecommerce brand "Medicina Sagrada" using the visual world "Arquivo Vivo de Origem". This is a persuasive ecommerce interface, not a poster and not a moodboard.
Structure: a precise header with the Medicina Sagrada brand name, navigation links "Rapé", "Sananga", "Artesanato", "Etnias", "Nossa história", search and cart; a split but asymmetrical hero where one large documentary forest-and-craft image plate overlaps a contemporary provenance dossier with the product promise, a clear catalog CTA, origin fields and a restrained seal; show the start of section two as seven circular access records labeled "Huni Kuin", "Shawãdawa", "Kuntanawa", "Nukini", "Yawanawa", "Apurinã", "Shanenawa", plus a compact right-side shortcut "VER TODAS AS ETNIAS →".
Exact hero text: "Medicinas indígenas originais, direto da floresta."
Exact supporting text: "Produtos, histórias e saberes de diferentes povos."
Exact CTA: "ENTRAR NO CATÁLOGO"
Visual system: contemporary living provenance archive, photographic contact sheets, origin records, typographic stamps, accession numbers used as hierarchy, but warm and active rather than a colonial museum.
Palette: dominant #F4F0E6 warm neutral and #17401D deep green, bold region-sized #248C34 green, primary CTA #EF492B orange, #A3250F deep red for stamps and record markers.
Typography: distinctive wide contemporary sans display with compact technical sans labels; no high-contrast editorial serif and no generic luxury type.
Materials/textures: archival paper, crisp printed labels, subtle registration marks, documentary landscape and craft photography.
Composition: strong ecommerce hierarchy, one obvious action, large photographic material, modular but not a generic card grid, editorial rhythm with overlaps and edge labels.
Image ethics: do not invent Indigenous portraits, body paint, clothing, symbols, or tribal patterns. The seven circles use abstract documentary placeholders of landscape, tools, wood, fiber and craft details only, to be replaced later by real authorized photography. Do not frame people as specimens or objects.
Constraints: no fabricated reviews, prices, certifications, badges, health claims, discounts, or impact numbers. No mystical smoke, mandalas, generic leaves, gold luxury styling, beige wellness template, glassmorphism, gradients, watermarks, browser chrome, device frame, or explanatory notes outside the website. Render as a polished website screen with crisp UI text.
